standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there, I'm Captain Bruce. Do you want to serve in the Shayzien Army and defend our kingdom?

steps.npc: Wonderful! To get started, you need to answer a few questions.
Are you a resident of Kourend?
Ah. Then you cannot join I'm afraid.
It's in the rules I'm afraid. Only citizens of Kourend are allowed to join the Shayzien Army.
Well at one time only citizens of Shayzien could join the army. It wasn't until the reign of King Byrne I that people from other parts of the kingdom were allowed to enlist.
Of course, many people in Kourend still like to stick to tradition. After all, the five cities of Kourend have always had very defined roles within the kingdom.

steps.player: Interesting. So most people in the army are still from Shayzien?

steps.npc: Indeed. While the Shayzien Army is by far the largest military force in Kourend, the other cities still have some form of militia, apart from Arceuus of course.
Even if someone from elsewhere in the kingdom wants to become a soldier, they're far more likely to join their local city force than come to us.
Still, times are slowly changing. Every year we see more people from outside Shayzien enlist.

steps.player: I see. Thanks for the information.

steps.npc: That's alright. Come back if you change your mind.

treasure-trails.text: Captain Bruce hands you a [light puzzle/puzzle] box.

treasure-trails-talking-again-while-hold.text: If the light or puzzle box is not solved:

steps.npc: That doesn't look solved to me.

treasure-trails-talking-again-while-hold.npc: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
